scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Six modestly robed adults gather in a sunlit plaster courtyard. A seated man holds a blank-facing papyrus scroll and gestures as five companions listen. scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering pictures believers receiving instruction through Paul's letter. Their shared attention relates to his desire that they understand spiritual matters. The verse does not describe this courtyard or gathering, nor specify a manifestation of gifts; the scene supplies a setting for attentive learning rather than inventing a miracle.
